verdict.rationale: Data-use and training-opt-out posture is a fair privacy question for a GPU cloud that hosts customer training data and models, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no policy, setting or contractual commitment saying customer data will not be used to train AI models. Per-cluster VPCs, DPU isolation and bucket access controls are related security features, not a no-training guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
